newsitem.title: USA: Midland sees Q3 loss $0.50 to $0.70/shr.
newsitem.headline: Midland sees Q3 loss $0.50 to $0.70/shr.

text.p: Midland Financial Group Inc on Wednesday said it expects to report a third quarter net loss of between $3 million and $4 million, or about $0.50 to $0.70 per share.

Midland attributed the expected loss to a pre-tax charge of about $4.5 to $6 million, primarily related to an increase in its loss reserves for what it said were certain discontinued commercial programs.
The company also said that it will write off about $1.5 million of deferred policy acquisition costs.
Separately, Midland said also that its agreement for a $20 million, five-year term loan from American Financial Group Inc has ended.
Earlier today Midland said it agreed to be acquired by Progressive Corp of Cleveland, Ohio for $9 cash per share.
Midland shares were trading at 8-5/8 early Wednesday afternoon, up from Tuesday's close of 6-7/8.
Midland said it would report third quarter results before November 15.
